model.my_lakehouse_project.fact_store_ex.name: fact_store_expenses
model.my_lakehouse_project.fact_store_ex.description: Periodic snapshot fact - one row per store/expense_type/month. Grain is enforced upstream in silver_expenses, not by this model (no aggregation happens here - see assert_expense_grain_is_enforced.sql).

model.my_lakehouse_project.fact_competit.name: fact_competitor_prices
model.my_lakehouse_project.fact_competit.description: Periodic snapshot fact - one row per competitor/product/scrape event. competitor_price is semi-additive: aggregate with AVG/MIN/MAX/last-value across scraped_at, never SUM.

model.my_lakehouse_project.fact_store_sa.name: fact_store_sales
model.my_lakehouse_project.fact_store_sa.description: Transaction-grain fact table. One row per transaction_id, joined to the point-in-time-correct version of dim_products, plus dim_stores and dim_date. Unmatched dimension keys coalesce to -1.

/*
  Generic Test:
  Checks if the percentage of unmatched foreign keys (-1) in any specified column 
  exceeds the given threshold (default is 5%).
*/
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
        SUM(CASE WHEN competitor_key = '-1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unmatched_products,
        SUM(CASE WHEN product_key   = '-1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unmatched_stores,
        SUM(CASE WHEN date_key    = '-1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unmatched_dates
    FROM "nessie"."gold"."fact_competitor_prices"
)
SELECT *
FROM stats
WHERE unmatched_products > 0.05 * total_rows
   OR unmatched_stores   > 0.05 * total_rows
   OR unmatched_dates    > 0.05 * total_rows

        then 'In column ' || column_name || ', the last ' || metric_name || ' value is ' || cast(round(cast(metric_value as numeric(28,6)), 3) as varchar(4096)) || '. The average for this metric is ' || cast(round(cast(training_avg as numeric(28,6)), 3) as varchar(4096)) || '.'

,
            max(bucket_end) over (partition by test_execution_id) as max_bucket_end

    (
        anomaly_score is not null

    (metric_value = 0 and  1 = 2 )

                (
        (
            metric_name in

        )

            and anomaly_score > 3
        )

            not in 
        (
            
                'freshness' ,
            
                'event_freshness' 
            
        )

            and  abs(anomaly_score) > 3
    

        )
    )
                and
                (
        
        

        
             (1 = 1)
             and

             (1 = 1)
            
        
    )
                and 
    (1 = 1)
    

            )
        )
    )
) and bucket_end > 
    timestampadd(
        day,
        cast('-2' as integer),
        cast(
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    cast(max_bucket_end as varchar(4096)),
                    '(\d)T(\d)',
                    '$1 $2'
                ),
                '(\.\d{3})\d+',
                '$1'
            ),
            'Z$',
            ''
        ) as  timestamp 
    )
    )

        then 
     true 

        else 
     false

    end
 as is_anomalous
        from anomaly_scores
      ),

      final_results as (
        select
            metric_value as "value",
            training_avg as average,
            
            case
                when  is_anomalous = true  and 'both' = 'spike' then
                    
    lag(metric_value, 1)
 over (partition by full_table_name, column_name, metric_name, dimension, dimension_value, bucket_seasonality order by bucket_end)
                when  is_anomalous = true  and 'both' != 'spike' then
                    
    lag(min_metric_value, 1)
 over (partition by full_table_name, column_name, metric_name, dimension, dimension_value, bucket_seasonality order by bucket_end)
                when 'both' = 'spike' then metric_value
                else min_metric_value
            end as min_value,
            case
                when  is_anomalous = true  and 'both' = 'drop' then
                    
    lag(metric_value, 1)
 over (partition by full_table_name, column_name, metric_name, dimension, dimension_value, bucket_seasonality order by bucket_end)
                when  is_anomalous = true  and 'both' != 'drop' then
                    
    lag(max_metric_value, 1)
 over (partition by full_table_name, column_name, metric_name, dimension, dimension_value, bucket_seasonality order by bucket_end)
                when 'both' = 'drop' then metric_value
                else max_metric_value
            end as max_value,
            bucket_start as start_time,
            bucket_end as end_time,
            *
        from anomaly_scores_with_is_anomalous
    )
      

      select *  from final_results
      where 1 = 1
      ) results
    where  is_anomalous = true

 as is_anomalous

    lag(metric_value, 1)
 over (partition by full_table_name, column_name, metric_name, dimension, dimension_value, bucket_seasonality order by bucket_end)

    lag(min_metric_value, 1)

    lag(metric_value, 1)
 over (partition by full_table_name, column_name, metric_name, dimension, dimension_value, bucket_seasonality order by bucket_end)

                else max_metric_value
            end as max_value,

            *
        from anomaly_scores_with_is_anomalous
    )
      

      select *  from final_results
      where 1 = 1
      ) results
    where  is_anomalous = true

WITH max_loaded AS (
    SELECT MAX(scraped_at) AS max_scraped_at
    FROM "nessie"."gold"."fact_competitor_prices"
),
source_before_max AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT scraped_at
    FROM "nessie"."silver"."silver_competitor", max_loaded
    WHERE scraped_at <= max_loaded.max_scraped_at
),
target_before_max AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT scraped_at
    FROM "nessie"."gold"."fact_competitor_prices", max_loaded
    WHERE scraped_at <= max_loaded.max_scraped_at
)

WHERE t.scraped_at IS NULL

        from "nessie"."elementary"."schema_columns_snapshot"

    ),

            select
                cur.full_table_name,
                'type_changed' as change,
                cur.column_name,
                cur.data_type as data_type,
                pre.data_type as pre_data_type,
                pre.detected_at
            from cur
            inner join
                pre
                on (
                    lower(cur.full_table_name) = lower(pre.full_table_name)
                    and lower(cur.column_name) = lower(pre.column_name)
                )
            where
                pre.data_type is not null
                and lower(cur.data_type) != lower(pre.data_type)

        ),

        
            columns_added as (

                
                select
                    full_table_name,
                    'column_added' as change,
                    column_name,
                    data_type,
                    
    cast(null as varchar(4096))
 as pre_data_type,
                    detected_at as detected_at
                from cur
                where is_new = 
     true 


            ),
        

        columns_removed as (

            
            select
                pre.full_table_name,
                'column_removed' as change,
                pre.column_name as column_name,
                
    cast(null as varchar(4096))
 as data_type,

                cur

                    lower(cur.full_table_name) = lower(pre.full_table_name)

                )

            select
                removed.full_table_name,
                removed.change,
                removed.column_name,
                removed.data_type,

metadata.test_query:
select * from (with anomaly_scores as (
        select
            id,
            metric_id,
            test_execution_id,
            test_unique_id,
            detected_at,
            full_table_name,
            column_name,
            metric_name,
            anomaly_score,
            anomaly_score_threshold,
            anomalous_value,
            bucket_start,
            bucket_end,
            bucket_seasonality,
            metric_value,
            min_metric_value,
            max_metric_value,
            training_avg,
            training_stddev,
            training_set_size,
            training_start,
            training_end,
            dimension,
            dimension_value,
            
    case
        when dimension is not null and column_name is null
        then 'The last ' || metric_name || ' value for dimension ' || dimension || ' - ' || case when dimension_value is null then 'NULL' else dimension_value end || ' is ' || cast(round(cast(metric_value as numeric(28,6)), 3) as varchar(4096)) || '. The average for this metric is ' || cast(round(cast(training_avg as numeric(28,6)), 3) as varchar(4096)) || '.'

        when dimension is not null and column_name is not null
        then 'In column ' || column_name || ', the last ' || metric_name || ' value for dimension ' || dimension || ' is ' || cast(round(cast(metric_value as numeric(28,6)), 3) as varchar(4096)) || '. The average for this metric is ' || cast(round(cast(training_avg as numeric(28,6)), 3) as varchar(4096)) || '.'

        when metric_name = 'freshness'
        then 'Last update was at ' || anomalous_value || ', which is' || cast(abs(round(cast(metric_value/3600 as numeric(28,6)), 2)) as varchar(4096)) || ' hours without updates (only full buckets are considered). Usually the table is updated within ' || cast(abs(round(cast(training_avg/3600 as numeric(28,6)), 2)) as varchar(4096)) || ' hours.'

        when column_name is null
        then 'The last ' || metric_name || ' value is ' || cast(round(cast(metric_value as numeric(28,6)), 3) as varchar(4096)) || '. The average for this metric is ' || cast(round(cast(training_avg as numeric(28,6)), 3) as varchar(4096)) || '.'

        when column_name is not null
        then 'In column ' || column_name || ', the last ' || metric_name || ' value is ' || cast(round(cast(metric_value as numeric(28,6)), 3) as varchar(4096)) || '. The average for this metric is ' || cast(round(cast(training_avg as numeric(28,6)), 3) as varchar(4096)) || '.'

        else null
    end as anomaly_description
,
            max(bucket_end) over (partition by test_execution_id) as max_bucket_end
        from "nessie"."elementary"."test_d127836bcd_elementary_column_anomalies_fact_store_expenses_sum__average__max__exp__anomaly_scores__tmp_20260817121055335198"
      ),
      anomaly_scores_with_is_anomalous as (
        select
          *,

    case
        when (
    (
        anomaly_score is not null
        and (
            
    (metric_value = 0 and  1 = 2 )

            or (
                (
        (
            metric_name in 
        (
            
                'freshness' ,
            
                'event_freshness' 
            
        )

            and anomaly_score > 3
        )
        or (
            metric_name
            not in 
        (
            
                'freshness' ,
            
                'event_freshness' 
            
        )

            and  abs(anomaly_score) > 3
    

        )
    )
                and
                (
        
        

        
             (1 = 1)
             and

             (1 = 1)
            
        
    )
                and 
    (1 = 1)
    

            )
        )
    )
) and bucket_end > 
    timestampadd(
        day,
        cast('-30' as integer),
        cast(
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    cast(max_bucket_end as varchar(4096)),
                    '(\d)T(\d)',
                    '$1 $2'
                ),
                '(\.\d{3})\d+',
                '$1'
            ),
            'Z$',
            ''
        ) as  timestamp 
    )
    )

        then 
     true 

        else 
     false

    end
 as is_anomalous
        from anomaly_scores
      ),

      final_results as (
        select
            metric_value as "value",
            training_avg as average,
            
            case
                when  is_anomalous = true  and 'both' = 'spike' then
                    
    lag(metric_value, 1)
 over (partition by full_table_name, column_name, metric_name, dimension, dimension_value, bucket_seasonality order by bucket_end)
                when  is_anomalous = true  and 'both' != 'spike' then
                    
    lag(min_metric_value, 1)
 over (partition by full_table_name, column_name, metric_name, dimension, dimension_value, bucket_seasonality order by bucket_end)
                when 'both' = 'spike' then metric_value
                else min_metric_value
            end as min_value,
            case
                when  is_anomalous = true  and 'both' = 'drop' then
                    
    lag(metric_value, 1)
 over (partition by full_table_name, column_name, metric_name, dimension, dimension_value, bucket_seasonality order by bucket_end)
                when  is_anomalous = true  and 'both' != 'drop' then
                    
    lag(max_metric_value, 1)
 over (partition by full_table_name, column_name, metric_name, dimension, dimension_value, bucket_seasonality order by bucket_end)
                when 'both' = 'drop' then metric_value
                else max_metric_value
            end as max_value,
            bucket_start as start_time,
            bucket_end as end_time,
            *
        from anomaly_scores_with_is_anomalous
    )
      

      select *  from final_results
      where 1 = 1

                cur.data_type as data_type,
                pre.data_type as pre_data_type,

                on (
                    lower(cur.full_table_name) = lower(pre.full_table_name)
                    and lower(cur.column_name) = lower(pre.column_name)
                )
            where
                pre.data_type is not null
                and lower(cur.data_type) != lower(pre.data_type)

        ),

        
            columns_added as (

                
                select
                    full_table_name,
                    'column_added' as change,
                    column_name,
                    data_type,
                    
    cast(null as varchar(4096))
 as pre_data_type,
                    detected_at as detected_at
                from cur
                where is_new = 
     true 


            ),
        

        columns_removed as (

            
            select
                pre.full_table_name,
                'column_removed' as change,
                pre.column_name as column_name,
                
    cast(null as varchar(4096))

    ),

        pre as (
        
        select full_table_name, column_name, data_type, detected_at
        from "nessie"."elementary"."schema_columns_snapshot"
        where lower(full_table_name) = lower('NESSIE.GOLD.FACT_STORE_SALES')
            and detected_at = (select max(detected_at) from "nessie"."elementary"."schema_columns_snapshot" where lower(full_table_name) = lower('NESSIE.GOLD.FACT_STORE_SALES'))
    ),

        type_changes as (

            
            select
                cur.full_table_name,
                'type_changed' as change,
                cur.column_name,
                cur.data_type as data_type,
                pre.data_type as pre_data_type,
                pre.detected_at
            from cur
            inner join
                pre
                on (
                    lower(cur.full_table_name) = lower(pre.full_table_name)
                    and lower(cur.column_name) = lower(pre.column_name)
                )
            where
                pre.data_type is not null
                and lower(cur.data_type) != lower(pre.data_type)

        ),

        
            columns_added as (

                
                select
                    full_table_name,
                    'column_added' as change,
                    column_name,
                    data_type,
                    
    cast(null as varchar(4096))
 as pre_data_type,
                    detected_at as detected_at
                from cur
                where is_new = 
     true 


            ),
        

        columns_removed as (

            
            select
                pre.full_table_name,
                'column_removed' as change,
                pre.column_name as column_name,
                
    cast(null as varchar(4096))
 as data_type,
                pre.data_type as pre_data_type,
                pre.detected_at as detected_at
            from pre
            left join
                cur
                on (
                    lower(cur.full_table_name) = lower(pre.full_table_name)
                    and lower(cur.column_name) = lower(pre.column_name)
                )
            where cur.full_table_name is null and cur.column_name is null

        ),

        columns_removed_filter_deleted_tables as (

            
            select
                removed.full_table_name,
                removed.change,
                removed.column_name,
                removed.data_type,
                removed.pre_data_type,
                removed.detected_at
            from columns_removed as removed
            join cur on (lower(removed.full_table_name) = lower(cur.full_table_name))

        ),

        all_column_changes as (

            
            select *
            from type_changes
            union all
            select *
            from columns_removed_filter_deleted_tables
            
                union all
                select *
                from columns_added
            
        ),

        column_changes_test_results as (

            
            select
                

    md5(cast(coalesce(cast(full_table_name as varchar(4096)), '') || '-' || coalesce(cast(column_name as varchar(4096)), '') || '-' || coalesce(cast(change as varchar(4096)), '') || '-' || coalesce(cast(detected_at as varchar(4096)), '') as VARCHAR)) as data_issue_id,
                
    cast(
        '2026-08-17 12:16:14'
        as  timestamp 
    )
 as detected_at,
                
    trim('"' from split_part(full_table_name, '.', 1)) as database_name
,
                
    trim(
            '"'
            from
                substr(
                    full_table_name,
                    length(split_part(full_table_name, '.', 1)) + 2,
                    length(full_table_name)
                    - length(split_part(full_table_name, '.', 1))
                    - length(
                        split_part(
                            full_table_name,
                            '.',
                            length(full_table_name)
                            - length(replace(full_table_name, '.', ''))
                            + 1
                        )
                    )
                    - 2
                )

,
                
    trim(
            '"'

                split_part(
                    full_table_name,

                    length(full_table_name)
                    - length(replace(full_table_name, '.', ''))
                    + 1
                )
        ) as table_name
,
                column_name,

    case
        when change = 'column_added'
        then
             'The column "' || column_name || '" was added' 
        when change = 'column_removed'
        then
             'The column "' || column_name || '" was removed'
